name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - § 38 - Am 97
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 38. Recalls that Article 311 of the TFEU defines the framework for the Union’s own-resources system; emphasizes that the financing of the Union budget should not lead to the creation of new tax burdens for citizens and businesses; considers that budgetary needs should be met primarily through better control of expenditures, savings, the fight against fraud, and the effective recovery of unduly spent funds;
